editorial:
Ever wonder how a tractor maker became a supercar legend? This film follows Ferruccio Lamborghini from his early days building tractors and military vehicles to launching his dream sports car company in 1963. You watch him clash with rivals, chase perfection, and fight to prove that Italian engineering can beat the best. The story feels like a classic underdog tale mixed with family drama, and the cars look stunning on screen. The pacing keeps you moving through decades of his life without feeling rushed.

The acting is solid, especially when Ferruccio faces tough choices between business and family. Some scenes drag a little, and the drama can feel familiar if you have seen other biopics. Still, car fans will love the behind-the-scenes details, and casual viewers get an easy, inspiring watch.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ferruccio finally sees his dream car roll off the line, proving his critics wrong. The twist is that his biggest rival becomes an unlikely ally, and Ferruccio realizes success cost him time with his family. He steps back from daily control, handing the company to trusted hands while keeping his vision alive. The movie ends with him watching a Lamborghini speed away, smiling, knowing his legend will outlast him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true stories about dreamers and classic cars.
